children.name: Azure Web Apps - All HTTP Response Codes with their Count

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| count by sc_status 
| sort by _count

children.name: Azure Web Apps - HTTP Status Code Summary over time

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| if(sc_status matches "2*", 1, 0) as successes 
| if(sc_status matches "3*", 1, 0) as redirects 
| if(sc_status matches "5*", 1, 0) as server_errors 
| if(sc_status matches "4*", 1, 0) as client_errors 
| timeslice by 1d 
| sum(successes) as successes,  sum(redirects) as redirects, sum(client_errors) as client_errors,  sum(server_errors) as server_errors by _timeslice

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/WebApp "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| json "properties", "category", "resourceId" as properties, category, resource_id
| where category = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
| parse field=resource_id "*/SITES/*" as _, site_name
|json field = properties  "UserAgent","ScStatus","CsUsername", "SPort", "CsMethod", "CsBytes", "CIp", "CsUriStem", "ScBytes","Referer","CsHost", "Cookie", "TimeTaken" as cs_user_agent, sc_status, src_user, src_port, cs_method, cs_bytes, client_ip, cs_uri_stem, sc_bytes, cs_referrer, cs_host, cs_cookie, time_taken
| (time_taken/1000) as seconds 
| avg(seconds) as avgtimeinseconds by cs_uri_stem 
| sort by avgtimeinseconds 
| limit 100
